mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies by City Hall, a waning gibbous moon, and a special treat as the ISS will be visible at 3:31 AM, moving from the northwest over Verona High School toward the east northeast. The temperature is 76 degrees, and we expect an overnight low of 71 degrees with no rain.

The City of Verona has installed a beautiful new sculpture titled Tai Chi Animal Frolics at Century School Park. This artwork, commissioned by Gerri Gurman and created by local artists, features carvings inspired by traditional Tai Chi movements and is designed to inspire future generations.

Today you can head to Hop Haus Brewing for trivia. Looking ahead to tomorrow, there is a variety of options including the downtown farmer's market at Hometown Junction Park, yoga at Insight Wellness, and trivia at The Bogey Factory.
On August 30, a vehicle versus bicyclist crash occurred at East Verona Avenue and Lincoln Street. The 15-year-old bicyclist was not injured, and the driver was cited for failure to yield.

Our Culver's of Verona location is currently closed for the night. We hope you enjoyed today's flavor, Chocolate Heath Crunch. Be sure to stop by tomorrow starting at 10:00 AM to try the OREO REESE'S Cheesecake.
